description: Enhanced source-region extraction cases across additional languages and edge logic: Rust function with a typed parameter, Python class with method/field declarations and a string literal, an unrecognized language id falling back to plain-prose handling, a Go function with a string-literal body, a C function declaration, and a Rust comment containing multi-byte UTF-8 words (byte offsets must stay on UTF-8 boundaries). Each resulting word is reported as its UTF-8 start byte offset within the whole input, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"split","text":<source>,"lang":<id>}.
